decisions.statement: The unit of work is one check rather than every check an audit would run.
The check named is the only check gathered, so no other check's code loads.
The change handed in names no path, the audit collecting what it judges itself.
The working set the check builds dies with the process the check ran in.
What the check judged is written to the file the caller named.
Nothing is written to the output stream, because a check may write there itself.
A run handed no root, no check or no file to answer into judges nothing.
A check this tree gathers nothing for judges nothing.
The cost of the run is recorded by the run itself rather than by the caller.
Nothing here holds the process to a ceiling.
Nothing here keeps a verdict, which is the caller's to keep.

definition: one check's audit run in a process of its own, answered into a file it is handed
